title: Lumtub skin
description: skin.jsonc of a Lumtub skin. See skins/README.md. Lumtub 皮肤文件。

lumtubSkin.description: The file format. 文件格式版本。

id.description: Unique; a skin of yours with a built-in id replaces it. 唯一标识。

names.description: By language tag: zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja… 按语言。

license.description: SPDX id, e.g. CC0-1.0. 许可证。

brightness.description: auto follows Lumtub's light/dark mode, with overrides.dark (and overrides.light) laid over it. auto 跟随浅色/深色模式。

fonts.description: Family name → .ttf/.otf file in the skin's folder. 字体名 → 文件。

font.description: All text; null keeps the user's font. 正文字体，null 用用户的。

displayFont.description: Headings and the logo. 标题和 logo。

monoFont.description: Times, durations, numbers. 时间和数字。

page.description: Window background, also under pictures. 窗口底色。

text.description: Body text, 4.5:1 on page. 正文。

accent.description: Switches, sliders, links; 3:1 on page. 强调色。

onAccent.description: Text on the accent. 强调色上的文字。

card.description: Card and dialog colour. 卡片颜色。

onSelected.description: Text on selected rows. 选中行文字。

reason.description: Why a video is recommended. 推荐理由。

chrome.description: Top bar and side rail where the skin draws no surface for them. 顶栏和侧栏底色。

tint.description: How much of the accent fields and menus take on. 输入框和菜单带多少强调色。

strong.description: Borders and secondary text as strong as can be. 边框和次要文字最强。

inactive.description: Other window focused. 非活动窗口。

placement.description: Default right: minimize, maximize, close. left: close, minimize, maximize. 默认在右；left 时依次为关闭、最小化、最大化。

glyphs.description: hover: the signs show only under the pointer. hover：鼠标移上去才显示符号。

titlePlate.description: A plain patch under the title, clear of stripes. 标题下面垫一块纯色。

titleBar.description: Computers only; drawn by Lumtub instead of the system. 只在电脑上，替代系统标题栏。

position.description: top: above the title bar, along the top of the window. top：放在标题栏上面、窗口最顶上。

appMenu.description: A first menu named after the app, in bold, with About, Settings and Quit. 第一个菜单是粗体的应用名，含关于、设置、退出。

menuBar.description: File / View / Play / Help, with Alt keys. Computers only. 菜单栏，只在电脑上。

topBarText.description: Icons on the top bar, 3:1. 顶栏图标。

statusBarText.description: Status line text, 4.5:1. 状态栏文字。

glass.description: Let the user make the bars, rail, cards and panels clearer, down to 30%, so the background shows through (Settings › Skins › Glass). {"min": n} is the clearest glass at which all text still reads; below it the veil thins too. 允许用户调低栏、侧栏、卡片和面板的不透明度（最低 30%），透出背景。{"min": n} 是文字仍然看得清的最透明程度，低于它时 veil 也会变淡。

veil.description: Page colour over the backdrop under the pages, so text reads over a busy picture; thins with glass clearer than glass.min. 页面下面垫的一层底色，玻璃比 glass.min 更透明时会变淡。

press.description: What a press looks like: wash (darkens at once), ripple (spreads from the finger), glow (accent wash). 点击效果：整块变暗、水波纹、发光。

style.description: lcd: a display with time, scrolling title and spectrum; deck: a player body under the picture. 液晶屏样式；deck 机身样式。

lcdFont.description: Font of the display; VT323 by default. 显示屏字体。

spectrum.description: The level meter on the display. 显示屏上的电平条。

deck.description: With style deck: the player body under the picture. 播放器机身。

shape.description: capsule 胶囊, slab 扁平, wave 波浪上沿, boombox 手提音箱, oval 椭圆。

body.description: Body colours, top to bottom. 机身颜色，从上到下。

clear.description: How see-through the body is. 机身透明度。

button.description: Small buttons, top and bottom colour. 小按钮颜色。

play.description: The big play button. 大播放键。

speakers.description: Round speakers at both ends. 两端圆形喇叭。

desktop.description: Deep-merged over the skin on this kind of device. 在这类设备上深度合并覆盖。

names.description: By language tag: zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja… 按语言。

speakers.description: Round speakers at both ends. 两端圆形喇叭。

dark.description: Deep-merged over the skin on this kind of device. 在这类设备上深度合并覆盖。

names.description: By language tag: zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja… 按语言。

license.description: SPDX id, e.g. CC0-1.0. 许可证。

fonts.description: Family name → .ttf/.otf file in the skin's folder. 字体名 → 文件。

font.description: All text; null keeps the user's font. 正文字体，null 用用户的。

displayFont.description: Headings and the logo. 标题和 logo。

monoFont.description: Times, durations, numbers. 时间和数字。

page.description: Window background, also under pictures. 窗口底色。

text.description: Body text, 4.5:1 on page. 正文。

accent.description: Switches, sliders, links; 3:1 on page. 强调色。

onAccent.description: Text on the accent. 强调色上的文字。

card.description: Card and dialog colour. 卡片颜色。

onSelected.description: Text on selected rows. 选中行文字。

reason.description: Why a video is recommended. 推荐理由。

chrome.description: Top bar and side rail where the skin draws no surface for them. 顶栏和侧栏底色。

tint.description: How much of the accent fields and menus take on. 输入框和菜单带多少强调色。

strong.description: Borders and secondary text as strong as can be. 边框和次要文字最强。

inactive.description: Other window focused. 非活动窗口。

placement.description: Default right: minimize, maximize, close. left: close, minimize, maximize. 默认在右；left 时依次为关闭、最小化、最大化。

glyphs.description: hover: the signs show only under the pointer. hover：鼠标移上去才显示符号。

titlePlate.description: A plain patch under the title, clear of stripes. 标题下面垫一块纯色。

titleBar.description: Computers only; drawn by Lumtub instead of the system. 只在电脑上，替代系统标题栏。

position.description: top: above the title bar, along the top of the window. top：放在标题栏上面、窗口最顶上。

appMenu.description: A first menu named after the app, in bold, with About, Settings and Quit. 第一个菜单是粗体的应用名，含关于、设置、退出。

menuBar.description: File / View / Play / Help, with Alt keys. Computers only. 菜单栏，只在电脑上。

topBarText.description: Icons on the top bar, 3:1. 顶栏图标。

statusBarText.description: Status line text, 4.5:1. 状态栏文字。

glass.description: Let the user make the bars, rail, cards and panels clearer, down to 30%, so the background shows through (Settings › Skins › Glass). {"min": n} is the clearest glass at which all text still reads; below it the veil thins too. 允许用户调低栏、侧栏、卡片和面板的不透明度（最低 30%），透出背景。{"min": n} 是文字仍然看得清的最透明程度，低于它时 veil 也会变淡。

veil.description: Page colour over the backdrop under the pages, so text reads over a busy picture; thins with glass clearer than glass.min. 页面下面垫的一层底色，玻璃比 glass.min 更透明时会变淡。

style.description: lcd: a display with time, scrolling title and spectrum; deck: a player body under the picture. 液晶屏样式；deck 机身样式。

lcdFont.description: Font of the display; VT323 by default. 显示屏字体。

spectrum.description: The level meter on the display. 显示屏上的电平条。

deck.description: With style deck: the player body under the picture. 播放器机身。

shape.description: capsule 胶囊, slab 扁平, wave 波浪上沿, boombox 手提音箱, oval 椭圆。

body.description: Body colours, top to bottom. 机身颜色，从上到下。

clear.description: How see-through the body is. 机身透明度。

button.description: Small buttons, top and bottom colour. 小按钮颜色。

play.description: The big play button. 大播放键。

speakers.description: Round speakers at both ends. 两端圆形喇叭。

icons.description: How icons are drawn. 图标的画法。

style.description: fill: every icon filled. fill：所有图标用实心。

effect.description: A finish for a skeuomorphic look; left out in Low resource mode. 拟物效果：浮雕、凹刻、凝胶、发光；低占用模式下不画。

color.description: #RGB, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA (alpha last, as in CSS), or transparent. 透明度在最后，和 CSS 一样。

angle.description: As in CSS: 180 = top to bottom, 90 = left to right. 和 CSS 一样。

center.description: Fractions of the box, may lie outside it. 相对盒子的比例。

radius.description: Fraction of the longer side. 长边的比例。

image.description: A file in the skin's folder; only on window.background. 皮肤文件夹里的图片，只能用在 window.background。

focus.description: The point [x, y] (0 to 1 from the top left) kept in view when "cover" crops the picture, for example on a phone held upright. Default [0.5, 0.5]. 图片被 cover 裁切时（比如竖着拿手机）保留在画面里的点 [x, y]，0 到 1，从左上角算起。默认 [0.5, 0.5]。

fill.description: What fills the box: a paint or a list painted first to last. 填充，可以是列表，后面的盖在上面。

sides.description: Only these sides. 只画这几条边。

bevel.description: The raised edge of 90s desktops; sinks when pressed. 90 年代的立体边，按下自动变凹。

radius.description: Corner radius, overrides shape.*. 圆角，覆盖 shape 里的值。

gloss.description: 0–1, the white shine of gel buttons. 果冻高光强度。

glow.description: A soft neon light round the box. 霓虹光晕。

focused.description: Reached by keyboard or TV remote. 键盘或遥控器聚焦时。

surface.description: How a box is drawn: a paint, or fill/border/bevel/radius/shadow/gloss/glow with hover/pressed/focused looks. 一个盒子怎么画。

above.description: Drawn over the content instead of under it. 画在内容上面。

scene.description: With type scene: the landscape. 景色。

night.description: With type scene: the night version. 夜晚版。

decoration.description: Left out in Low resource mode: never put anything needed here. 低占用模式下不画，别放有用的信息。

tabs.description: The pages as tabs on a phone or in a narrow window, in place of the side rail. 手机或窄窗口里代替侧栏的页面标签栏。

position.description: bottom: along the bottom; top: under the top bar. bottom 在底部，top 在顶栏下面。

selected.description: What the page shown sits on. 当前页下面的底。

selectedText.description: The page shown, 3:1. 当前页文字和图标。

indicator.description: A line under the page shown (over it for a bottom bar). 当前页的指示线。

labels.description: below: icon over the word; text: words only. below 图标在上文字在下；text 只有文字。

caps.description: Words in capitals. 文字大写。
